description: Use to fingerprint a text, or to compare a spec or output you hold with the hash in a receipt: computes the 'sha256:<64 hex>' content hash of the given text, the format INAM uses for specHash and outputHash. Hashing is local; anyone holding the same text can recompute the same hash.

content.description: the exact spec or output text to hash

name: inam_hash_content
